limitations: The queries were reused from an existing revealed file-retrieval suite, so this is only a first look for symbol location, not a blind end-to-end retrieval test. The ModelBackend question asks about both authentication and permissions; its preselected authenticate method covers only part of that compound behavior, so the single-symbol label is ambiguous. Do not tune on this result and then call the same cases held out. Candidate inclusion is not model answer correctness. No online model was called.
